interface.functionalContract: LOCKED (A7-C3): exposes the YL-38 interface module's 4 output pins directly, never the raw resistive probe. VCC/GND power the module; AO is the analog output voltage (supplyVoltage x analogRatio, analogRatio = 1 - MOISTURE); DO is a computed digital output (HIGH when MOISTURE < instance threshold, else LOW), both requiring correct VCC=HIGH/GND=LOW polarity.
